title: Twin Heart Studs
descriptionHtml:
Two hearts on every lobe. Each stud pairs a larger and a smaller heart cut clear cubic zirconia, side by side and touching, in slim gold claws. The two studs are mirror images of each other, and each is about 8.5mm across.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with the Twin Heart Necklace.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 8.5mm across
  • Stone: Heart cut clear cubic zirconia, approximately 5mm and 3.5mm
  • Setting: Slim gold claws
  • Pair: The two studs mirror each other
  • Closure: Post
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
